claims.text: Latent TB: isoniazid + rifapentine weekly × 3 mo (w pyridoxine), or rifampin-based regimen × 3-4 mo; isoniazid × 6-9 mo = alt if rifamycin-based tx not suitable.
claims.quote: Preferred regimens include isoniazid plus rifapentine weekly for 3 months (with pyridoxine supplementation) or rifampin-based regimens for 3 to 4 months; isoniazid for 6 to 9 months remains an alternative when rifamycin-based therapy is not suitable
